nodes.name: restaurant_confirmation_implementation_progress.md
nodes.summary: Timestamped implementation progress log for the restaurant confirmation touchpoint feature, tracking completion of the three-phase rollout (database layer, application layer, documentation) with a status of COMPLETE and listing all created files and next steps for the operator.

nodes.name: restaurant_confirmation_patterns_used.md
nodes.summary: Documents the eight architectural patterns applied while implementing the restaurant confirmation feature, showing concrete before/after code examples for each pattern (webhook trigger, WhatsApp callbacks, configuration fallback, CTE processing, idempotent functions, Pydantic models, scheduled jobs, and module docstrings) along with lessons learned.

nodes.name: restaurant_confirmation_summary.md
nodes.summary: Operator-facing summary of the restaurant confirmation touchpoint implementation covering the new workflow, schema changes to delivery_summary, action items for running migrations and scheduling the pg_cron timeout job, configuration reference, and monitoring/rollback SQL queries.

nodes.name: restaurant_confirmation_touchpoint_proposal.md
nodes.summary: Original design proposal for the restaurant confirmation touchpoint, analyzing the existing delivery workflow, proposing a new status-based flow with 'restaurant_unconfirmed', detailing schema changes, new DB functions, FastAPI endpoints, WhatsApp callback handlers, and evaluating alternative approaches with risk and success metrics.
